details: Bug Fix: The following effects are no longer incorrectly affected by the on-attack damage penalty: Hail of Blades , Scorch , Blackfire Torch , Hextech Alternator , Liandry's Torment , Luden's Echo , Scout's Slingshot .
Bug Fix: Soldier attacks no longer only grant 1 Conqueror stack if the first champion hit was the primary target.
Bug Fix: Soldier attacks once again apply stacks of Press the Attack to the primary target.
Bug Fix: Now knocks back jungle monsters.
Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where it may fail to fire while in brush.
Attack damage growth increased to 2. 5 from 2.
On-hit cooldown reduction increased to 2 – 6 (based on critical strike chance) from 2 – 4 .
Base damage reduced to 125 / 200 / 275 from 150 / 250 / 350.
Bonus movement speed reduced to 30 from 40.
Base resistances reduced to 5 / 12 / 19 / 26 (based on level) from 5 / 15 / 25 / 35 (based on level) .
Base nail damage reduced to 50 / 58 / 66 / 74 / 82 from 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90.
Stack base bonus damage reduced to 18 / 26 / 34 / 42 / 50 from 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60.
Recast time reduced to 4 seconds from 5.
Base Grey Health cap reduced to 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 from 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 / 200.
Base damage increased to 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 from 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120.
AP ratio increased to 45% AP from 40% AP .
Stat steal increased to 13% from 10%.
Bonus damage per hit increased to 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 / 80 from 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60.
Critical damage modifier reduced to 80% from 85%.
Slow AP ratio reduced to 7% per 100 AP from 10% per 100 AP .
Healing AP ratio reduced to 35% AP from 50% AP .
AP ratio reduced to 40% AP from 50% AP .
Attack damage growth increased to 3 from 2. 5 .

items.name: Fiendish Codex
changes: No longer builds into Hextech Rocketbelt .

items.name: Hextech Rocketbelt
changes: New Recipe: Hextech Alternator + Kindlegem + Ruby Crystal + 350 = 2650 .
Old Recipe: Hextech Alternator + Fiendish Codex + Ruby Crystal + 300 = 2650 .
Supersonic cooldown increased to 50 seconds from 40.

items.name: Immortal Path
changes: Now and Forever damage increase reduced to 4% from 5%.
Now and Forever increased healing reduced to 12% from 15%.

items.name: Protoplasm Harness
changes: Lifeline bonus health reduced to 100 – 300 (based on level) from 200 – 300 (based on level) .
Lifeline healing reduced to 100 – 400 (based on level) from 200 – 400 (based on level) .

entries.name: Dimension Shift
changes: NEW: Structure Damage: Now deals 1 damage to structures.

entries.name: Overkill
changes: NEW: Execute: Now executes if the accumulated damage would kill.

entries.name: Infernal Conduit
changes: Cooldown Reduction on Non-Champions: Enabled ⇒ No longer reduces cooldowns when affecting non-champions

entries.name: Stackosaurus Rex
changes: Effect: Will not affect augment or item effects
Fixed a bug where Divine Domain could grant infinite Attack Range.
Fixed a bug where Combusting Interest did not grant gold to champions' damage over time effects like Darius, Teemo, and Twitch.
Fixed a bug where Smolder could be offered Combusting Interest.
Fixed a bug where It's Go Time did not correctly grant bonus move speed with Master Yi's E, Ashe's Q, and Twitch's Q.
Fixed a bug where High Roller sometimes failed to drop an Anvil when a unit died.
Fixed a bug where Drop Bear could sometimes die immediately after spawning.
Fixed a bug where you could still get another active summoner after choosing Shark Tempest and SnowBomb.
Fixed a bug where Pursuit of Haste was offered to Yasuo E.

entries.name: Kled
changes: Bug Fix: Power Flowers now correctly grants courage.

entries.name: Swain
changes: R Demonic Power Generated per Second While Draining: 20 ⇒ 25
New: Wildfire Interaction: Now counts Wildfire as a burn

entries.name: Divine Intervention
changes: New: Hexbolt Interaction: Cooldown is now reduced by 2 seconds when you trigger Hexbolt
New: Capstone Interaction: Max Level capstone now triggers even if you are already invulnerable from Divine Intervention
New: Quantum Computing Interaction: Now properly works with Quantum Computing, and will multicast with a 0.25 second delay between casts, for a max invulnerability duration of 3.5 seconds

entries.name: Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability
changes: Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where having both of these would sometimes prevent a spell from critting
New: Double Tap Interaction: 5 second per spell cooldown
New: Critical Rhythm Interaction: 4 second per spell cooldown
